end.summary:
Counted sides and corners of triangles and rectangles.
Identified shapes from their sides and corners, including when rotated.
Explained that a triangle has three sides and three corners in any position.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised counting sides and corners and naming shapes from these features. Ayaan used the idea that each side ends at a corner and explained that turning a shape does not change its sides. They briefly mixed up whether to count sides or corners, then returned to the correct count later. At home, ask Ayaan to find two shapes and count both their sides and corners aloud.
